description: A custom reporter class under Jest 30.5.2 (T11.9, B23a): every hook writes one `HOOK` line to stderr, so the order of the hooks and their arguments are the recording: the constructor with its options and context, `onRunStart` (suites, `estimatedTime`, `showStatus`), `onTestFileStart`, `onTestCaseStart` and `onTestCaseResult` per test (a retried test starts twice and ends once, a skipped test has neither, a todo test only a result), `onTestFileResult` (with the console buffer still there) and `onRunComplete`; `getLastError` returns an error, so the run fails with the tests all green but one. One Jest worker; the reporter is the only one, so Jest prints nothing else. A black-box run.
